message.content:
Heron Data submissions list — clean, airy B2B SaaS layout, no chat panel, no KPI cards.

1. **Overall layout**: fixed white left sidebar (~270px) with thin light-gray right border; top header bar with logo + horizontal nav; main content is a single full-width list view inside a subtle bordered panel on a white/very-light-gray page.
2. **Sidebar**: bird logo mark + "Heron Data" wordmark (dark, ~20px semibold). Nav items with line icons: "All Companies" (active — light blue pill `#DBEAFE`-ish background, blue text `#2563EB`-like), "Starred" (star icon), "Emails" (envelope icon). Gray inactive text.
3. **Header**: nav section label "SUBMISSIONS" in gray uppercase small caps, then tabs "Submissions" (active, blue text + blue underline) and "Statistics" (gray). White header, hairline bottom border.
4. **Filter toolbar** (no card styling, just spaced inputs): star-outline icon button; search field "Search Companies" with magnifier and clear "×"; three outlined selects with floating labels above the border — "Search By: Company Name", "Date Range: All Time", "Policy Result: All", "CRM Sync Result: All" (wraps to second row); right-aligned primary button "+ Add Company" — solid blue (#3B82F6-ish), white text, slight rounded corners.
5. **Table**: light gray header row, gray bold column labels with sort chevrons: drag handle icon, "Name", "Files", "Policy Results", "CRM Sync", plus a far-right blank action column. Hairline row separators only.
6. **Rows** (3): each has star outline toggle, blue company-name link, gray monospace-looking ID string (e.g. `eus_JTYgYurmupJeXvvtLdLhS`), status pill in small gray outlined rounded rect ("new" / "processed"), clock icon + "2 months ago" + a second timestamp. Files column: table icon + "10 / 10 Processed", "2 / 2 Processed", "12 / 12 Processed". Policy Results: yellow warning triangle + "0 / 1 Passed" (rows 1–2), red exclamation circle + "0 / 1 Passed" (row 3). CRM Sync: gray "No Syncs". Row 3 has a light-gray selected/hover background.
7. **Row actions**: vertical three-dot kebab per row in the rightmost column.
8. **Colors**: white background, blue accent ~`#3B82F6`/`#2563EB`, yellow `#F59E0B`, red `#EF4444`, grays `#6B7280`–`#9CA3AF`, hairline borders `#E5E7EB`.
9. **Typography**: modern sans (Inter-like), airy spacing, generous row height (~90px), semibold headings vs regular gray meta; IDs appear monospace.
10. **Notable**: no pagination visible, no KPI/stat cards, no chat/assistant; large empty area below table; icons are thin-line style (Material-ish); timestamps duplicated with a divider pipe.
